description:
"SZNS Solutions (pronounced "seasons") is a technology consulting company and Google Cloud Partner based in Reston VA. We specialize in delivering agentic AI and cloud computing solutions. Founded by ex-Googlers with engineers from Google, Amazon, and Capital One, SZNS differentiates itself particularly in AI, data engineering, blockchain, and cloud-native software application development.”
 Role Summary 
 We’re seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDE) that operates at the intersection of product engineering, sales engineering, and technical consulting. As a builder, translator, and change agent , you will embed directly with strategic enterprise and government partners to solve their most complex operational bottlenecks. We are not a traditional consulting firm; we are builders who believe that the best way to advise a customer is to show them working software.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Rapidly Build and Deploy: Embed with customer teams to design, build, and deploy new workflows or applications from first sketch to real-world impact
 Agentic Workflows: Design evaluation and feedback loops to verify AI performance and safety, ensuring reliable deployments. Perform threat modeling and evaluation to ensure robust guardrails and "Non-Human Identity" policies to ensure enterprise safety
 Trusted Technical Advisor: Be the principal technical interface to client leadership and stakeholders for accelerating deals and long-term strategic partnerships
 Client Enablement: As the resident expert, you’ll participate with client-side workshops, technical trainings, and hackathons
 Always Improve: Extract field insights and translate them into reusable patterns, accelerators, and playbooks that strengthen the core SZNS platform for future customers
 Requirements 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 Strong cloud experience (GCP, AWS, Azure)
 Strong full-stack proficiency, particularly in Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, or Java 
 Demonstrated experience building and shipping production-quality code in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
 Experience deploying Agentic workflows (e.g., ADK, Agents SDK) and agent orchestration
 Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI workflows and systems
 Familiarity and efficient use of AI-enabled tools (e.g., Gemini Code Assist, Claude Code, or Codex)
 Deep customer empathy, low ego, and exceptional communication skills to bridge the gap between complex engineering systems and business leaders
 Experience with containerized environments (Kubernetes/GKE)
 Active Google Cloud certifications, or willingness to obtain within one month of joining
 Obsession for impact in highly ambiguous environments and favors rapid action over perfect clarity
 US Citizen
 Preferred Qualifications
 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, and deployments
 Experience in a software consulting or professional services capacity for strategic accounts
 Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments
 Prior customer-facing or technical pre-sales experience
 Prior experience with containerized environments (Kubernetes/GKE)
 Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, HIPAA, etc.) and security strategies
 A proven track record of mentorship and raising the technical bar for engineering teams
 Benefits 
 Competitive salary and benefits package
 Hybrid work environment (MWF in-person in our Reston office)
 A collaborative and innovative work environment
 Continuous learning and development opportunities
years_evidence: 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, and deployments
